name: ci-debugging
description: Trigger: a CI pipeline, workflow, or build job fails, tests pass locally but fail in CI, or a pipeline is red, flaky, or timing out. Diagnoses with evidence-first investigation, faithful local reproduction, and CI-versus-local environment deltas.
abstract: Adapted from citypaul's ci-debugging skill: provider evidence before hypotheses, last-green-run comparison, exact local reproduction, environment-delta analysis, fix proof, and the rules that distinguish proven flakiness from an unexplained failure.
